description: This file implements a Kubernetes discovery client that interacts with the Kubernetes API server to retrieve supported API groups, resources, versions, and schemas. It includes methods for fetching API group lists, resource lists, server version, and OpenAPI schemas, with support for legacy and aggregated discovery formats.

classes.name: DiscoveryClient
classes.description: Implements methods to discover supported API groups, resources, versions, and schemas from a Kubernetes API server, supporting both legacy and aggregated discovery formats.

methods.name: GroupsAndMaybeResources
methods.description: Returns discovery groups and resources, merging legacy and API discovery endpoints.

methods.name: downloadLegacy
methods.description: Fetches legacy API group list and resources from /api endpoint.

methods.name: downloadAPIs
methods.description: Fetches API group list and resources from /apis endpoint.

methods.name: ServerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves supported API groups from the server.

methods.name: ServerResourcesForGroupVersion
methods.description: Retrieves supported resources for a specific group/version.

methods.name: ServerGroupsAndResources
methods.description: Fetches all supported API groups and resources, with retries.

methods.name: ServerVersion
methods.description: Gets and parses the server's version info.

methods.name: OpenAPISchema
methods.description: Fetches and unmarshals the OpenAPI v2 schema.

methods.name: WithLegacy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the client configured for legacy discovery only.
